                        Greetings from Shearwater Health..!! 

  Job Location -    Chennai (Guindy - Work from Office)  

  Job Title:  ML / Integration Engineer
  Employment Type:  Full-Time
  Department:  Information Technology

   We are hiring a   ML Engineer with 4+ years of experience   in ssoftware development, ML engineering, or AI integration. Experience working in the US Healthcare domain is mandatory. 

  If you have the required skills and are interested in this opportunity, please share your updated resume at  dsai@swhealth.com.  

  Please refer to the Job Description below for more details.  

  Role Purpose 

 The ML / Integration Engineer is responsible for integrating Machine Learning and AI solutions into enterprise applications, developing scalable APIs, automating MLOps processes, and ensuring secure, reliable, and compliant deployment of AI technologies. The role collaborates closely with Data Science, Engineering, DevOps, and business teams to deliver impactful AI-driven solutions.

  Key Responsibilities 

  AI/ML Integration & Engineering 

  Integrate ML models into web, mobile, and enterprise applications.  Design and develop APIs, microservices, and automation workflows.  Deploy and manage AI/ML solutions across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.  Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and MLOps frameworks.  Monitor model performance, availability, scalability, and model drift.  Implement security controls, governance standards, and compliance requirements.  Integrate advanced AI capabilities including LLMs, Generative AI, NLP, and Computer Vision.  Troubleshoot and optimize AI solutions for performance and reliability.  Maintain technical documentation and deployment standards.    Business & Project Support 

  Gather, analyze, and document business and technical requirements.  Translate requirements into functional specifications and user stories.  Support project planning, Agile ceremonies, prioritization, and change management.  Coordinate UAT, solution validation, defect tracking, and issue resolution.  Prepare reports, dashboards, training materials, and project documentation.  
  Qualifications 

  Education & Experience 

  Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.  5+ years of IT experience with at least 2 years in healthcare, health tech, payer/provider, or BPO environments.  4-8 years of experience in software development, AI/ML engineering, or system integration.  
  Technical Skills 

   Programming:  Python, Java, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript   ML Frameworks:  TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, FastAPI, Flask   Cloud Platforms:  AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform   Containers:  Docker, Kubernetes   APIs:  REST, GraphQL, gRPC   CI/CD:  Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps   Databases:  PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis   Messaging:  Kafka, RabbitMQ   Monitoring:  Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack   Tools:  Jira, Confluence, Visio, Excel, Power BI, Tableau  
  Preferred Certifications 

  PMP, PRINCE2  Agile/Scrum  ITIL  Lean Six Sigma  Cloud and AI/ML Certifications

How does this fraud happen? 
	
	
	

	
	

Fraudsters send emails or messages on social media and messaging platforms, impersonating regulators or 
senior company executives such as CEOs and CXOs. 
	
	
	
	

	
	
	
	
	

	
	

The message typically claims that the organisation has violated regulations, creating urgency and pressuring the 
recipient to act quickly. 
	
	
	
	

	
	
	
	
	

	
	

The malware compromises the executive's device or system. 
	
	
	
	

	
	
	
	
	

	
	

Using the hijacked account, fraudsters send messages to finance or accounts personnel. 
	
	
	
	
	

	
	

TO HELP PROTECT YOUR ORGANISATION FROM SUCH FRAUD, FOLLOW THESE SAFETY TIPS: 
	
	
	
	
	

	- Verify urgent payment requests:  Confirm directly by phone or in person before making any payment. 

	- Check account change requests:  Independently verify any request to change bank account details. 

	- Never install unknown files:  Do not download or install ZIP/executable files received from unknown sources. Regulators never send attachments via social media apps. 

	- Keep systems protected:  Keep malware detection tools up to date and restrict unknown software on your systems.

The right answer is never from just one AI model

One key, a dozen models, and a build idea worth trying this week. ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌

Hi Hemachandiran . G,

“Is GPT better than Claude?”

That’s the wrong question. One model writes the better headline, another the more accurate summary, and picking a single winner throws away good work.

This Week’s Demo Project:

Ask three models the same question with KodeKey, then compare field by field, best title from one, best summary from another, best tags from a third.

Here’s how to build it.

The project

Vote Per Field, Not Per Answer

Step 1: Point the OpenAI client at KodeKey

Same library you already use. Only the URL changes.

client = OpenAI(

api_key=os.environ["KODEKEY_API_KEY"],

base_url="https://api.ai.kodekloudcom/v1",

)

Step 2: Ask every model the same thing

Ask for JSON so every reply has the same fields. That’s what makes them comparable.

MODELS = ["openai/gpt-4o-mini",

"anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5",

"google/gemini-2.5-flash"]

def ask(model):

r = client.chat.completions.create(

model=model,

messages=[{"role": "user", "content": PROMPT}],

response_format={"type": "json_object"},

)

return model, json.loads(r.choices[0].message.content)

with ThreadPoolExecutor(3) as pool:

answers = dict(pool.map(ask, MODELS))

Run them at the same time, not one after another. And catch errors per model, so one slow or failing model doesn’t stop the whole thing.

Step 3: Judge one field at a time

You can’t just count votes here. Three models will write three different titles, so nothing ever gets two votes. (Counting votes works fine when answers are short and exact: a total, a yes/no, a category.)

For writing, use a fourth model as a judge. Show it only one field, with one thing to look for.

for field, looking_for in RUBRIC.items():

options = {m: a[field] for m, a in answers.items()}

verdict = client.chat.completions.create(

model=JUDGE,                # a model that isn't being judged

messages=[{"role": "user", "content":

f"Pick the best one for: {looking_for}\n"

'Reply as JSON: {"winner": "<key>"}\n\n' + json.dumps(options)}],

response_format={"type": "json_object"},

)

best[field] = options[json.loads(verdict.choices[0].message.content)["winner"]]

If you can write a simple rule instead, shortest title that fits, tags that match your own list, use the rule. It’s free and it never changes its mind.

Step 4: Put it together

Save which model won each field. After a few runs you’ll see which models keep earning their spot, and which ones you can drop.

Two things to know before you use this

Pieces from different models can clash: a title about studio sound next to a summary about commuting. If the output is prose, run one last pass to smooth it out. It works best on separate facts: extracted data, labels, form fields.

It also costs more. Three answers plus a judge for every field. Worth it when a wrong field is expensive. Not worth it for a product blurb.

This is just one small experiment out of dozens you can run on KodeKey. Go ahead and try it yourself.

                                            Hi G Hemachandiran,

Hope this message finds you in good spirits. I'm reaching out to discuss a Pharmaceutical Analyst opportunity which requires 2 years to 15 years of experience that I believe could be a great move for you. As part of the hiring team, I'm particularly impressed by your extensive experience at Conspectus as a DevOps Engineer and at Infiniti Research as a Aws Devops Engineer.

  Please find the job description for the role: 

 We are seeking a detail-oriented Pharmaceutical Analyst with 2-15 years of experience to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in analytical chemistry and a passion for ensuring the quality and safety of pharmaceutical products. This role involves conducting rigorous testing, analyzing data, and collaborating with various departments to drive product excellence in compliance with global regulatory standards.

 
 Responsibilities: 

   Conduct analytical testing and validation of pharmaceutical products to ensure compliance with regulatory standards.

   Analyze data from experiments and studies to prepare reports and presentations for stakeholders.

   Collaborate with cross-functional teams including R&D, quality assurance, and regulatory affairs to support product development.

   Maintain and calibrate laboratory equipment to ensure accuracy and reliability of test results.

   Monitor industry trends and regulatory changes to ensure compliance and inform strategic decisions.

   Assist in the development of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and best practices in laboratory processes.

   Participate in audits and inspections by regulatory bodies and ensure readiness for compliance checks.

   
 Skills and qualifications: 

   Bachelor's or Master's degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, or related field.

   Experience with analytical techniques such as HPLC, GC, and spectrophotometry.

   Strong understanding of Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).

   Proficiency in data analysis software (e.g., SAS, R, or Python) and statistical methods.

   Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, for report writing and presentations.

   Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail in experimental design and execution.

   Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

   Familiarity with regulatory requirements specific to the pharmaceutical industry in Australia, Canada, Germany, New Zealand, or Singapore.

 Job Title: Senior Cloud Engineer  Azure

 Location: Bangalore (WFO)

 Experience: 5–6 years 

 Employment Type: Full-Time

 Role Overview

 We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Engineer – Azure to lead the design, deployment, and support of enterprise Azure environments. This role involves managing complex Azure infrastructure, handling advanced incident resolutions, driving automation initiatives, and providing technical leadership within the operations team.

 The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Azure expertise, strong troubleshooting capabilities, and the ability to support multi-customer Managed Services environments.

 Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Azure infrastructure operations and act as a senior technical escalation point for L2/L3 teams.  • Design, deploy, and manage Azure services including:  Virtual Machines, AV Sets/Zones, Load Balancers, Virtual Networks  Azure Storage, Azure Backup, ASR, Key Vault  Azure App Services, Functions, AKS (optional), Azure SQL (platform-level)  • Optimize performance, cost, security, and availability across Azure workloads.  • Manage identity and access using Azure AD / Entra ID, RBAC, Conditional Access.  • Implement and maintain monitoring solutions using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Alerts.  • Troubleshoot complex issues involving compute, networking, storage, OS, and security.  • Build and maintain automation solutions using PowerShell, Azure Automation, Logic Apps, or CI/CD pipelines.  • Review and implement Azure Policies, governance controls, tagging standards, and compliance requirements.  • Support DR strategies, backup validation, patching cycles, and BCP testing.  • Document architecture, configurations, runbooks, and best practices.  • Collaborate with security, network, DevOps, and application teams to ensure seamless cloud operations.  • Participate in shifts and on-call support for critical incidents.  • Mentor team members and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.   Technical Skills Required

  • Hands-on expertise with Azure IaaS/PaaS services:  VMs, VNets, NSG, Peering, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway  Azure Backup, Site Recovery, Key Vault, Azure Storage  App Services, Azure SQL, Load Balancers, App Gateway  • Strong understanding of Azure governance, cost management, RBAC, and security best practices.  • Advanced experience in PowerShell scripting, Azure Automation, and automation frameworks.  • Knowledge of ARM/Bicep/Terraform for infrastructure deployments (preferred).  • Strong Windows or Linux server administration background.  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps pipelines, Git, and YAML-based automation (nice-to-have).  • Experience with enterprise monitoring tools: Azure Monitor, Sentinel (optional), Grafana, etc.  • Understanding of ITIL processes and Managed Services operations.   Soft Skills

  • Strong leadership and decision-making ability.  • Excellent communication skills and customer-facing experience.  • Ability to manage high-severity incidents under pressure.  • Proactive, ownership-driven, and detail-oriented.  • Mentoring and capability-building mindset.   Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field.  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) required.  • Azure Solutions Architect (AZ-305) or Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500) preferred.  • ITIL Foundation certification is an advantage.   Work Environment

  • 24x7 Managed Services with rotational on-call responsibilities.  • Exposure to large-scale enterprise Azure deployments and modernisation programs.  • Opportunity to work closely with architects and lead cloud transformation initiatives.

Full Email Body:
hey FlutterFlow builders!

two things just shipped that change how you build with AI agents in FlutterFlow.

your agent now lives inside FlutterFlow.

instead of switching between your editor, terminal, and browser, you can now work with your AI agent directly inside the FlutterFlow desktop app.

open the AI Agent, connect your existing local setup, and start building without leaving your project.
Open the Desktop app (https://flutterflow.io/desktop)

works with Claude Code and Codex.

plugins for Claude Code (https://github.com/FlutterFlow/flutterflow-claude) and Codex (https://github.com/FlutterFlow/flutterflow-codex) that work in the desktop and terminal apps. setup takes about a minute.

also shipped:

text selection: all text in your app is now selectable via App Settings > General > Display Settings.

canvas screenshots: the MCP tool can now screenshot the Builder canvas so your agent can see your design, no local run required.

PinCode animation: choose entry animation (Slide, Fade, Scale, or None) with custom curve and duration.

let us know what you build.

— the FlutterFlow team

  management, and possess expertise in tools such as Terraform and Packer. As a DevOps Lead,

  effectively with team members and stakeholders regarding infrastructure changes,

  updates, and improvements.

  pipelines to automate software delivery processes. Ensure reliable and efficient

  deployment of applications through the development lifecycle.

  system performance, troubleshoot issues, and optimize resource utilization. Proactively

Full Email Body:
hey FlutterFlow builders!

two things just shipped that change how you build with AI agents in FlutterFlow.

your agent now lives inside FlutterFlow.

instead of switching between your editor, terminal, and browser, you can now work with your AI agent directly inside the FlutterFlow desktop app.

open the AI Agent, connect your existing local setup, and start building without leaving your project.
Open the Desktop app (https://flutterflow.io/desktop)

works with Claude Code and Codex.

plugins for Claude Code (https://github.com/FlutterFlow/flutterflow-claude) and Codex (https://github.com/FlutterFlow/flutterflow-codex) that work in the desktop and terminal apps. setup takes about a minute.

also shipped:

text selection: all text in your app is now selectable via App Settings > General > Display Settings.

canvas screenshots: the MCP tool can now screenshot the Builder canvas so your agent can see your design, no local run required.

PinCode animation: choose entry animation (Slide, Fade, Scale, or None) with custom curve and duration.

let us know what you build.

— the FlutterFlow team

This role requires good analytical skills, proficiency with monitoring and logging tools, and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to resolve incidents and support service reliability.

 JOB RESPONSIBILITY
•        Incident Management and Resolution: Respond to and resolve L2 support tickets in a timely manner, ensuring adherence to SLA commitments.
•        AWS Cloud Monitoring: Monitor cloud infrastructure and applications using AWS CloudWatch, Datadog, and other monitoring tools to identify and address performance issues.
•        Log Analysis and Troubleshooting: Analyze application logs, system logs, and error traces to diagnose root causes of incidents and assist in implementing corrective actions.
•        Application Support: Provide troubleshooting support for production applications, working with development teams to resolve technical issues.
•        Linux System Administration: Execute Linux commands and scripts to investigate system behavior, manage processes, and perform routine maintenance tasks.
•        Incident Ticketing and Documentation: Create, update, and manage incident tickets using ticketing systems, ensuring accurate documentation of issues and resolutions.
•        Escalation Management: Escalate complex issues to senior engineers or L3 support teams when necessary, providing detailed context and initial analysis.
•        Performance Monitoring: Assist in identifying performance bottlenecks and work with engineering teams to support optimization efforts.
•        Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with DevOps, development, and infrastructure teams to ensure effective incident resolution.
•        Communication and Reporting: Provide clear and timely updates to stakeholders, including status reports and incident summaries.
•        Proactive Monitoring: Support the setup and maintenance of alerts and dashboards to detect anomalies and prevent potential incidents.
•        Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to internal documentation, runbooks, and knowledge base to support team efficiency.
•        On-call Support: Participate in on-call rotation to provide support coverage for production systems.
•        Continuous Learning: Stay updated with AWS services, monitoring tools, and support best practices to improve technical capabilities.

 QUALIFICATION
B.E/B.Tech in Computer Sciences, IT, Engineering, or related field

 EXPERIENCE

 SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

 Technical Skills:

•        Proficiency in Linux/Unix systems administration, including command-line operations, shell scripting, and basic system troubleshooting.
•        Experience with incident ticketing systems such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Desk, or similar ITSM tools.
•        Application troubleshooting skills across web applications, APIs, and microservices.
•        Basic knowledge of networking concepts, including DNS, load balancing, VPC, and security groups.
•        Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
•        Understanding of database systems (SQL and NoSQL) and ability to perform basic query troubleshooting.
•        Experience with scripting languages such as Bash, Python, or PowerShell for automation and troubleshooting.
•        Exposure to containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus.
•        Understanding of ITIL processes and best practices for incident and problem management.

•        Performance Monitoring: Knowledge of application and infrastructure performance monitoring techniques.

•        Good problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to diagnose technical issues systematically.
•        Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, capable of explaining technical issues clearly and providing status updates.
•        Ability to work independently on assigned tickets while seeking guidance when needed for complex issues.
•        Customer-focused approach with commitment to delivering quality support and ensuring user satisfaction.

•        Attention to detail in documentation, ensuring accurate incident records and knowledge articles.

New Controls for Agents and Secrets

July 2026

Hi Hemachandiran,

The last few months put AI agents at the center of Pulumi. July was about keeping them, and the secrets and credentials underneath, under control. You can now cap how much Neo spends in a month, sign in to Pulumi Cloud with a passkey, enforce a maximum lifetime on every access token, and preview an ESC change on a real stack before it ships.

Key Product Updates

-

Preview ESC Changes Before They Ship (https://info.pulumi.com/e3t/Ctc/GC+113/cx72f04/VWRpGw4B35BjW8PHxpb4GyGmGW33LWhB5S641XMVmxWK3prCCW8wLKSR6lZ3nGW4zcLc52F6rcpW7P-_7l6lSxFNW3hQLLX622RKBW8mSlRH4hd-ykN629jKtDvgMRW8-Z0zQ13Q0qKW7xC1rz3cvMZ0VDsJdk3J8cVJW67YhzD29JQTvW6nG7sq756wtZW6_2BhQ41HNhVN1b2GGVcJ4HCN13Pk0fmywxyW6D2rrl5w3W4MN2jJ8XJnFx3PW1yN1L55h3Z6GW3sxKlG7GNSbLW6BbdKf2dRdcXW2XXWgJ5Vz_TnW7xV-X05g7849W6cGt4t2tdKs7W8rL4W73M2f6FW7TPxDh27yvfGW8rYgSw2vQGyGN9jQNRgXMK5zW4gMZn14wJjwnW1GCxKJ4mSYRrVqGTNT8j8h8sf504Cn804 )  A new --override-env flag lets you swap in a draft environment and run pulumi preview or pulumi up against it, so a reviewer can test a configuration change on a real stack before it is approved. Reference a draft with @draft:<draft-id>, and layer several overrides at once.

-

Sign in to Pulumi Cloud with Passkeys (https://info.pulumi.com/e3t/Ctc/GC+113/cx72f04/VWRpGw4B35BjW8PHxpb4GyGmGW33LWhB5S641XMVmxWq3prCCW7Y8-PT6lZ3mzW3fYckx86Pgk1W13DFTW7q1HYHW4cJhGj2h-KvGW3kYst58F1kW0VLRbjw1ThSBNW2Z4Fj15CpSr0W6rkTWs66wH-gVXrhDW2SmN0gW1fySg64TrcFrW8Wxkw47z74C7W89tNV28xd0SmN18Ddt_kR9N9W6ynqq44533hXW5XmyDN3KtFGXW5nGnlB31sKcxW8ts6ls8yzqfqW2DwrT17kYnWfW9b9Qyb8mxKGLW3WcMkR2DZh-_V8vRQG2t2G93W1Yq0V16VYh63W4P4JDP8b_F4QW8Cq42h2wLtFTN3vgmR1cMX8JW1LCYzf1zMGssN8BT-h98wctRf1fcr8x04 )  Email and password users can now add a passkey and sign in with a biometric or hardware key. Passkeys bind to Pulumi's domain, so they are phishing-resistant by design and remove the shared-secret risk that comes with passwords.

-

Enforce Access Token Expiry Policies (https://info.pulumi.com/e3t/Ctc/GC+113/cx72f04/VWRpGw4B35BjW8PHxpb4GyGmGW33LWhB5S641XMVmxW63prCCW7lCdLW6lZ3mXN8xTdgpS1L78W6cg7SR8yM7jsW90bxyw6HZl6RN4PHtnfsxLQYW1RPLZZ7YnnZMW6Zn_t348Zx3BN4h4gxBs7lqNW46Rbg-6CmpV6W5MCD3m6W3y-FW73YNvC3LSJFMVyyyht7z1gWsW3dhsDv8hG8QhW8h_CRd7pqMrBW1zGRmx3Wlnx5N1wM1kcpXpMKW2lrLct3w4NKSW8cDRQ06WSNCzN3Ct-swbwFj2W5SSfmP6Vqhf9W1TTYpk1WmxWxW1mCn-K9lzM6qW2YmZmD6X7Kv8W30Gtn93bH5ZNW2fBjzd6K8ZLkf27j3W404 )  Organization admins can now set a maximum lifetime for every token: personal, organization, and team. Compliance is checked on each request, and any token past the limit is rejected with a clear error, so credential rotation is enforced at the platform level.

Spotlight: Usage Limits for Pulumi Neo

Neo can plan and deploy real infrastructure on its own, and now you can put a budget around it. Set a monthly dollar limit for your organization and Neo pauses when it is reached. Add per-member limits so no single person can spend the whole pool, and get email alerts at 50, 80, 95, and 100 percent of the organization threshold. Admins and billing owners get a clear ceiling on AI agent spend without turning the agent off.

  Project Role :  Integration Engineer
 Project Role Description :  Provide consultative Business and System Integration services to help clients implement effective solutions. Understand and translate customer needs into business and technology solutions. Drive discussions and consult on transformation, the customer journey, functional/application designs and ensure technology and business solutions represent business requirements.                                                                                                                                                             
 Must have skills :  Infrastructure As Code (IaC)
 Good to have skills :  Python (Programming Language)
Minimum  3  year(s) of experience is required
 Educational Qualification :  15 years full time education

 Summary: 
As an Integration Engineer, a typical day involves engaging closely with clients to offer expert advice on business and system integration challenges. This role requires understanding client requirements thoroughly and translating them into practical technology and business solutions. The day often includes leading discussions on transformation initiatives, mapping out customer journeys, and designing functional and application frameworks that align with business objectives. Collaboration with various stakeholders to ensure that the solutions meet the intended business needs is a key aspect of daily activities, fostering seamless integration and effective implementation.
 

 Roles & Responsibilities: 
- Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
- Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
- Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of integration strategies with overall business goals.
- Assist in identifying potential risks and propose mitigation strategies during integration projects.
- Support junior team members by sharing knowledge and providing guidance on integration best practices.
 

 Professional & Technical Skills: 
- Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Infrastructure As Code (IaC).
- Good To Have Skills: Experience with Python (Programming Language).
- Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure and automation tools related to Infrastructure As Code.
- Experience in designing, deploying, and managing scalable infrastructure solutions.
- Familiarity with configuration management and orchestration tools.
- Ability to troubleshoot and optimize infrastructure deployments to enhance performance and reliability.
 

 Additional Information: 
- The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Infrastructure As Code (IaC).
- This position is based at our Chennai office.
- A 15 years full time education is required.

** 1. Native AI Agent in the Desktop App
------------------------------------------------------------
